rationale: Document the billing-reconciliation procedure and its exception handling so a trained non-owner can run the workflow after the billing roles are removed.
Warehouse lineage is held by a single role (role_data_platform_lead); documenting it removes the single point of failure.
Train the Controller role, a qualified finance backup outside the eight roles, to own the monthly close and take over its lineage knowledge before the accounting roles are removed.
Train the Finance Analyst role, a qualified backup outside the eight roles, to own billing reconciliation and take over its exception-handling knowledge before the billing roles are removed.
Migrate EchoMarket's unique account-intelligence attributes to a CinderSignals feed before Echo is terminated, so account planning and vendor reconciliation keep their source.
